This is the # dogfood's can-fail control -- if coverage came out ~0.95 here, the whole # harness would be silently broken. tier_b_method_narrow <- function(data, params) {   m  <- mean(data$x)   se <- stats::sd(data$x) / sqrt(nrow(data))   list(theta_lower = m - 1.96 * se / 3, theta_upper = m + 1.96 * se / 3) }

title: Estimand Kinds: Sobol Variance Share and Gauge Residual
text: Every medsim scenario carries estimand descriptor (medsim_estimand()) tells downstream analysis commands — importantly medsim_analyze_coverage() — coverage/power branch dispatch: scenario factories (medsim_scenarios_mediation(), medsim_scenario_missing()) default kind = "interval" — single estimate standard percentile Wald CI. vignette covers two factories use kind = "variance_share": Sobol / functional-ANOVA variance share gauge-residual estimand. decompose total outcome variance rather reporting single point estimate, share estimand kind — answer different scientific questions wrap different estimators.
code: medsim_estimand(   kind   = c("point", "interval", "probabilistic", "variance_share", "numeric"),   params = character(),   truth  = NULL,   ci     = c("standard", "imbens_manski", "mbco", "none"),   extra  = character() )

title: Estimand Kinds: Sobol Variance Share and Gauge Residual
text: medsim_scenario_sobol() targets Sobol/functional-ANOVA proportion mediated, P_med^sigma2 = V_med / V_T — share total outcome variance attributable mediated (indirect) path, closed-form ground truth computed scenario construction time: medsim_method_sobol() wraps injected estimator (sobol_pmed default, available) rather vendoring implementation — estimator-agnostic boundary medsim maintains throughout method adapters.
code: library(medsim)  scn_sobol <- medsim_scenario_sobol(   name = "sobol-baseline",   true_params = list(beta_a = 0.6, tau_a = 0.5, tau_m = 0.7, kappa = 0),   pd = 0.5,   pm = 0.5 )  results_sobol <- medsim_run(   method = medsim_method_sobol,   scenarios = list(scn_sobol),   config = medsim_config("test") )  summary(results_sobol)

title: Estimand Kinds: Sobol Variance Share and Gauge Residual
text: medsim_scenario_gauge() targets pair related quantities gauge-residual framework: interventional proportion mediated P_med = IIE/OE gauge residual W = R/OE, R = OE - IDE - IIE quantifies share overall effect captured standard direct-plus-indirect decomposition. Ground truth closed-form via corner-mean algebra. medsim_method_gauge() wraps probmed::ward_residual() default supports analytic (influence-function) percentile-bootstrap CIs via se_method:
code: library(probmed)  # provides ward_residual(), the default estimator  scn_gauge <- medsim_scenario_gauge("interaction", true_params = list(kappa = 0.4))  results_gauge <- medsim_run(   method = medsim_method_gauge,   scenarios = list(scn_gauge),   config = medsim_config("test") )  summary(results_gauge) results_gauge_boot <- medsim_run(   method = function(data, params) {     medsim_method_gauge(data, params, se_method = "bootstrap", B = 200)   },   scenarios = list(scn_gauge),   config = medsim_config("test") )

code: library(medsim)  my_method <- function(data, params) {   # Fit mediation models   fit_m <- lm(M ~ X, data = data)   fit_y <- lm(Y ~ X + M, data = data)      # Extract path coefficients   a <- coef(fit_m)["X"]   b <- coef(fit_y)["M"]      # Return results   list(     indirect = a * b,     a_path = a,     b_path = b   ) } # Quick validation (~30 seconds) config_test <- medsim_config("test")  # Development (~15 minutes) config_local <- medsim_config("local")  # Production (hours, for HPC clusters) config_cluster <- medsim_config("cluster") scenarios <- medsim_scenarios_mediation()  # View available scenarios names(scenarios) #> [1] "Independent Paths"   "Moderate Correlation" #> [3] "High Correlation"    "Suppression" #> [5] "Non-zero Effects"    "Unequal Variances" compute_truth <- function(data, params) {   list(     indirect = params$indirect,     a_path   = params$a,     b_path   = params$b   ) }  results <- medsim_run(   method = my_method,   scenarios = scenarios,   config = medsim_config("test"),  # Use "local" for real studies   compute_truth = compute_truth ) # Summary statistics summary(results)  # Detailed analysis analysis <- medsim_analyze(results) print(analysis)

title: Declare the estimand kind for a simulation scenario — medsim_estimand
text: Attach first-class estimand descriptor medsim_scenario().  Every downstream command (medsim_run, medsim_analyze_coverage, medsim_tables, medsim_figures, medsim_workflow) dispatches estimand$kind rather assuming scalar point-estimand. text: Runs replications [(chunk_id-1)*chunk_size+1 .. chunk_id*chunk_size] saves single RDS file named chunk_<chunk_id>.rds output_dir. Designed called inside SLURM array task script; chunk_id n_chunks auto-detected config (auto-reads SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID). chunk .rds sole artifact: chunk mode intermediate per-scenario/summary CSVs standalone medsim_run() writes skipped (concurrent array tasks sharing output_dir clobber fixed-name files, leaving partial data looks complete). Result rows record global replication id (schema v2): chunk 2 4-chunk/nsim-20 run writes replication 6..10, 1..5, ids never collide across chunks medsim_combine_chunks() can audit combined grid. chunk file also carries provenance attribute (Gate C): R version, medsim + key dependency versions, hostname, code SHA, seconds-per-replication timing. SHA auto-detected run script's git tree (falling back pkg:medsim-<version> tag outside git); pass code_sha stamp explicitly. medsim_combine_chunks() asserts single SHA across chunks – catching mid-run code edit plus partial resubmit, silently mix results two different code states.

NULL, uses available cores minus 2. progress Logical: Show progress bar (default TRUE). Automatically suppressed running cluster (batch jobs). export Character vector: Names objects export workers. objects must available calling environment. packages Character vector: Names packages load worker. Use fun requires specific packages. cluster_type Character: Type cluster ("PSOCK" "FORK"). FORK efficient works Unix. Auto-detected default. seed Integer NULL: Master seed L'Ecuyer-CMRG reproducible per-worker RNG streams.  supplied, calls RNGkind("L'Ecuyer-CMRG") parallel::clusterSetRNGStream(cl, seed) immediately cluster creation worker gets distinct, deterministic sub-stream. Default NULL leaves worker's RNG seeded OS (non-reproducible). Note: medsim_run()/medsim_run_chunk() pass seed – get chunk/worker-independent reproducibility .medsim_det_seed() instead (see ?medsim_run). parameter matters call medsim_run_parallel() directly.

title: Create a P_med simulation scenario — medsim_scenario_pmed
text: Thin wrapper medsim_scenario() bakes : linear structural equation model (SEM) data generator -> M -> Y causal chain. estimand = medsim_estimand("probabilistic", params = "pmed", ci = "mbco", extra = "branch_switch") descriptor medsim_analyze_coverage() dispatches MBCO-CI coverage branch. exact closed-form ground-truth P_med: -Gaussian linear SEM cross-world difference Y1 - Y0 Normal, P_med = Phi((beta_ay + alpha_ax * beta_my) / sqrt(2 * (beta_my^2 * sigma_m^2 + sigma_y^2))). estimand P_med = P(Y_a=1(M_a=1) > Y_a=0(M_a=1)) + 0.5 * P(Y_a=1(M_a=1) == Y_a=0(M_a=1)) uses cross-world assumption – probabilistic mediation effect, difference expectations.

what: Create a Sobol / functional-ANOVA variance-share simulation scenario — medsim_scenario_sobol
title: Create a Sobol / functional-ANOVA variance-share simulation scenario — medsim_scenario_sobol
text: Thin wrapper medsim_scenario() bakes : linear-Gaussian--interaction data generator -> M -> Y causal chain single covariate C *M interaction term (kappa). estimand = medsim_estimand("variance_share", params = "pmed_sobol", ci = "standard") descriptor, medsim_analyze_coverage() uses generic Wald truth %% CI path medsim_validate_scenario() checks /M/Y/C columns Sobol estimator requires. closed-form truth Sobol share, exact linear-Gaussian--interaction DGP (Monte-Carlo PO draw needed). estimand variance-scale proportion mediated \(P_{med}^{\sigma^2} = V_{med}/V_T\), functional-ANOVA variance components built four corner means \(\theta_{,'} = E[Y(, M('))]\).  linear-Gaussian DGP centered C, $$\theta_{,'} = \tau_a + (\tau_m + \kappa )\,\beta_a '.$$ kappa = 0 share reduces \(NIE^2/(NIE^2 + NDE^2)\) \(NIE = \tau_m \beta_a\) \(NDE = \tau_a\).

title: medsim 0.5.0
text: Pre-integration review hardening (7 confirmed findings). collapse audit excludes discrete contract fields NAME (collapse_exclude, default converged/branch_switch) instead observed distinctness – TOTALLY collapsed estimate column (1-2 distinct values) longer invisible check built . -failed run now fires all_failed violation instead combining clean. Mixed legacy+v2 chunk directories order-independent (attributes stripped + one warning; audit never mis-stops legacy ids). error documented RESERVED method-field name – method returning stops immediately instead converged silently forced 0. Pilot checks: n compared numerically (200L vs 200 longer false-positives) NA-vs-value asymmetries pilot mismatches. -provenance-less chunk sets warn skipped SHA assertion. combine rbind schema-harmonized (ragged chunk columns crash ), submit template creates logs/ front. Gate C: chunk provenance + single-SHA assertion (#34). Every chunk file now carries provenance header (R version, medsim + key dependency versions, hostname, code SHA, sec/rep, UTC timestamp). SHA auto-detects via git rev-parse HEAD running script’s directory (explicit code_sha = overrides; pkg:medsim-<version> tag outside git). medsim_combine_chunks() asserts one SHA across chunks – catching mid-run code edit + partial resubmit silently mix two code states. Provenance-less legacy chunks warn, never stop. Gate D: pilot-subset positive control (#34). seeds depend (scenario, replication), full run’s reps 1..B_pilot draw-identical archived pilot n. medsim_combine_chunks(pilot_reference =, pilot_tol = 1e-9) asserts identity first (sample size + scenario fingerprints – stale pilot fails pilot_config_differs, never masquerading seeding regression), compares estimate columns (never elapsed) within tolerance – free regression check harness, environment, seeding unchanged since pilot passed. Gate B: hardened SLURM submit template (#34, fixes #37). medsim_write_submit_script() now emits fail-loud script: #!/bin/bash -l (Hopper module defined login shells – old plain #!/bin/bash template failed “module: command found”), set -eo pipefail, hard-failing module load (never || true), command -v Rscript pre-check, #SBATCH --requeue, Rscript final command exit code task’s exit code. Optional config$array_throttle = K emits --array=1-N%K. deliberately shell-side output-file gate – completeness audited combine time Gate . inst/hopper-tests/submit_chunk.sh exemplar updated pattern, chunk_%04d.rds naming convention centralized internal helper shared writer combiner. Gate : combine-step seed-provenance audit (#34, SPEC-medsim-chunked-run-gates). medsim_combine_chunks() now audits combined grid new medsim_audit_results() runs audit standalone: per-scenario replication contiguity (gapless, duplicate-free 1..max, equal across scenarios – self-validating, external count needed; optional nsim = pin), collapse signature every continuous estimate column (n_distinct > collapse_threshold * n_ok; 0.3.1 seed collapse produced ~17 distinct outcomes 1000 every chunk exited 0), -failed cells reported cell_failed, cross-scenario seed collisions .medsim_det_seed()’s hash space. Violations route one on_violation = c("stop", "warn", "ignore") control; default "stop" signals medsim_combine_violation condition carries combined results (tryCatch(..., medsim_combine_violation = function(e) e$results) recovers hours-long run’s good cells). Breaking: old expected_chunks warn--combine default now violation control – deliberate partial combine (interim look running array), pass on_violation = "warn". Legacy (pre-schema-v2) frames skip id-based audits warning, never error.

text: Critical: medsim_run_chunk() produced correlated, non-independent replications across SLURM array chunks. chunk_config$rep_offset computed never consumed, every chunk called set.seed(config$seed) scalar – every chunk regenerated identical short sequence “replications”, collapsing e.g. 1000-replication/60-chunk study ~17 truly distinct outcomes.
